body.name: \(c_{n,1-\alpha}\)
body.def: \(c_{n,1-\alpha}=\inf\{t\in\mathbb R:P_{\xi}[\max_{r\in\mathcal R_n^{\mathrm{ret}}}\{\widehat g^L_{n,r}{}^{\prime}G_n^*,\widehat g^U_{n,r}{}^{\prime}G_n^*\}\le t\mid O_{n1},\ldots,O_{nn}]\ge1-\alpha\}\). The retained Cartesian family is nonempty on every sample, so this generalized-inverse quantile is defined even when \(G_n^*\) is degenerate.
